## 简体中文

- 修复 WireGuard 使用本机 wstunnel 时继承核心默认出站网卡绑定、导致 Windows 向回环地址发送 UDP 报错的问题。仅为绑定本机隧道的连接生成回环地址设置，保留直连连接与原始配置。

## English

- Fix WireGuard connections through local wstunnel inheriting the core's default outbound interface binding, which caused UDP sends to loopback to fail on Windows. Generate the loopback address setting only for locally tunneled connections, preserving direct connections and saved profiles.
